infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Imani uses your camera to attach photo evidence to reports. Photos are stored securely and only shared with authorized personnel handling your case.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Imani accesses your photo library so you can attach images as evidence to support your report. Your images are kept confidential.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Imani can save report attachments to your photo library for your personal records.
infoPlist.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Imani accesses documents you choose to attach as supporting evidence to your report.
